shortBarcodes.description_other: {{count}} products have no barcode, so their labels print without bars. Each gets a new 8-digit in-store barcode. Barcodes already on products are not changed.

shortBarcodes.done_other: {{count}} products now have a barcode. They are selected, so you can print their labels.
